senses.en_definition: To eat or take food into the body by chewing, swallowing or sucking; to have a meal.
Sustenance or a livelihood; food or income needed to support oneself.

collocations.en: earn a living; look for food
a place to earn a living

senses.en_definition: To consume, use up or require time, money, fuel or other resources.
To wound or penetrate, as a weapon does; to enter or become embedded in something.

collocations.en: stabbed at, but the blade would not penetrate
the nail sinks into the wood

senses.en_definition: To function effectively or take hold, especially of brakes or other mechanical parts.
To heed advice or yield to influence or persuasion.

collocations.en: be won over; give in to persuasion

senses.en_definition: To misappropriate money or accept bribes.

messages.en: Have you eaten yet? If not, let's grab something at the place downstairs.
Not yet. Give me a sec, I just need to send this file first.
Okay, I'll wait by the lift. Just let me know when you're done.

senses.en_definition: Food; anything that can be eaten, including the dishes served as part of a meal.

messages.en: I'm eating at the place next to the office. The food here's really good.
Really? I haven't eaten yet. What are you having?
Chicken rice. Want to join me? I can wait.

senses.en_definition: A creature or being; traditionally, anything created by God, including humans and animals.

messages.en: That creature in the film was scary as hell, wasn't it? I even had to close my eyes.
Yeah, especially the bit where it was crawling under the bed. Good thing we watched it during the day.
You're getting more and more fluent in Malay these days!
Thanks! I just try to speak a little bit every day.
